Subject: BrightHealth QBR & roadmap demo — proposed windows and agenda

Hi Claire,

Thanks for agreeing to a renewal QBR — excited to walk through the roadmap items that map to your cost/latency goals and the Dedicated capacity options we discussed last quarter. Proposed plan: 45 minute product walkthrough (roadmap highlights + config/ops), 15 minute open Q&A, and a 30 minute technical deep-dive for your infra team (optional).

I pulled two potential slots next week that should line up with exec + infra availability on our side:
- Wed Aug 20: 10:00–11:30 PT (1:00–2:30 ET) — exec + product
- Thu Aug 21: 13:00–14:30 PT (4:00–5:30 ET) — product + infra deep-dive

I attached a short draft agenda and an updated SOW we can use as a conversation starter. If neither window works, please flag a few times that fit your leadership + Ben (IT).

Attachments: [Attachment: BrightHealth_QBR_Agenda_v3.pdf (PDF, 254KB)], [Attachment: SOW-BrightHealth-draft.docx (DOCX, 48KB)]

Next steps: if you pick a preferred slot I’ll send a calendar invite and a short dry-run request for our engineers.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Monica Patel
Account Director, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

——
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference for production-grade LLMs
